title: Innate Pharma to participate in the Stifel Healthcare Conference and Jefferies Global Healthcare Conference
body_markdown:
** Wed, 10/21/2026 - 07:00


Innate Pharma SA (Euronext Paris: IPH; Nasdaq: IPHA) (“ **Innate** ” or the “ **Company** ”), a clinical-stage biotechnology company developing immunotherapies for cancer patients, today announced that members of its executive team will participate in the following investor conferences:


**Stifel Healthcare Conference**


- Dates: November 10–12, 2026
- Location: New York, United States


Fireside chat:


- Date: November 10, 2026
- Time: 2:00 p.m. ET / 8:00 p.m. CET
- To enter the live webcast, please[click here](https://event.summitcast.com/view/4aFtJriVa3BvDmNqmfSxma/guest_book?session_id=d9GPcxiigmaBEnmfpcjSTo)


The link to access the live webcast of the presentation will be available on the[Events](https://innatepharma2021ir.q4web.com/English/investors/events-and-presentations/default.aspx) page of the Investors section of Innate Pharma’s website. A replay of the presentation will be available following the event.


**Jefferies Global Healthcare Conference**


- Dates: November 16-19, 2026
- Location: London, United Kingdom
